US100 maintains a strong bullish posture above VWAP/EMA50 near Session Highs but is stretched at upper ATR resistance. FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) and XAUUSD are suppressed below VWAP inside lower value areas, but exhibit diverging CVD deltas and lack RVOL breakout confirmation near session support levels. Standard disciplined response across the board is HOLD until London/NY overlap yields decisive breakouts with volume confirmation.
